palette: quarry gray ground + pale stele panels + rubbing ink text + vermilion seal marks + moss green accents + bronze stakes
typography: engraved rubbing-ink headings, pale stele cards with chiseled dark labels, vermilion seal chips reserved for rulings and exceptions, moss green for growth notes, bronze ordinal stakes
composition: definitions stand as twin steles; the legislative system climbs as a stele ladder from constitution to local rules; conflicts read as two steles colliding across a rubbled seam; the same-level routes fork like a carved decision tree; informal sources rest as three relic slabs
surface: flat quarry gray with faint chisel dust, pale stele panels with hairline weathered borders, vermilion seal squares, no gradients, no rounded cards, no drop shadows
motion: steles rise from the ground with a settle, chiseled labels ink in stroke by stroke, the collision seam cracks once between conflicting steles, keys of the decision tree carve outward
transition: a rubbing wipe drags the previous stele off-frame leaving dust
